reconcile.note: Henry treats the two as accommodation: God is light in himself but veils his glory in thick darkness because people could not bear its full brightness.

discrepancy.emptyNote: Steve Wells presses the plain reading that a God placed in thick darkness by one biblical author and in unapproachable light by another cannot occupy both dwellings at once.

sides.snippet: he would dwell in the thick darkness
sides.verseText: Then spoke Solomon, Yahweh has said that he would dwell in the thick darkness.
who alone has immortality, dwelling in unapproachable light; whom no man has seen, nor can see: to whom be honor and eternal power. Amen.
